_what: The column rights tool:keep-a-stripe-event needs from a pursuit's writer login (run-sql-in-my-database role recipe may-write-named-columns-under-a-use, recipe.writes): the payment rows it reads to find a payment already kept (its id, kind, PaymentIntent, checkout and when it was kept), the columns a keep writes (payment-keys.ts KEPT_COLUMNS), and the one column a payment's kind moves up in (event_kind, payment-keys.ts KIND_MOVES_UP). test/keep-a-stripe-event.test.ts keeps a payment as a login holding exactly these.
